findings.where: all three columns, WHAT WE SENT / WHAT HAPPENED / WHAT WE FELT, whole screen
findings.what: Of roughly fifteen tiles exactly one carries a photograph; six carry the literal loading string "still fetching the picture." set in the app's own hand (right column at 1 Sep 26, 23 Aug 26, 18 Aug 26, 8 Aug 26; middle column at 4 Aug 26 and again at the foot), and at least three more are bare lined paper with nothing but a date (left column, 20 Aug 26 at approx y1450-1880, 18 Aug 26, 12 Aug 26) - I cropped (40,1400)-(700,1900) and (960,700)-(1440,1000) to confirm both cases.

what_is_working: One shell holds all five regions: the tab bar sits at the same rects in every in-app still (PULSE [100,3015], CHAT [381,3001], US [693,3015], MOMENTS [908,3015], SETTINGS [1184,3015] in both 13_messenger_states and 17_setup_pwa), with the same stamp face and the same 33/36 px active-inactive size step.

One palette holds across the whole set: palette.json across_the_set gives mean chroma 0.0375, hue centres 55/65/75/85/95 degrees and a single named family A_paper, and per-artifact hue families sit at 4-5 for nine of the ten stills.

Two type roles are used identically everywhere: DeskStamp for every label and section head at 27-36 px, NoorHand and TeoHand for every authored word at 36-72 px, with no third face and no drift between regions across all ten text sidecars.

State declarations render as one thing wherever they appear: a thin rail above the stream, identically treated in 02_chat ("noor went out", "noor's phone is on normal"), 13_messenger_states ("noor - travelling", "noor needs a lot"), 08_state_propagating ("noor is restless") and 11_chat_scroll.

Delivery and read state is one small vocabulary with no product voice in it - "read", "going", "waiting to send", "it would not go" in 13_messenger_states - no exclamation marks, no "Oops!", no self-naming, no badge or streak anywhere in the ten stills.

The event taxonomy is enumerated in three independent places and they agree: the fourteen-row interrupt matrix in 05_settings (something written, a picture, something to watch, their voice, an answer, a feeling, something they say about themselves, something their phone notices, a date moving, the list moving, a day that matters, passed on, a note set to arrive later, a feeling one of you made), the nine searched types in reliability.json, and the 34 feelings in six families in haptics.json. That matrix is the best extensibility evidence in the set: a fifth module's events already have a row shape to occupy.

08_state_propagating is the one clip that does the row's job: across its six sampled frames a partner state change appears in the Pulse card, in the header strip and as a rail in Chat, one event surfacing in two regions and the chrome.

The partner-state strip is genuinely present on all five regions rather than only on Pulse, at a byte-identical rect in 01 through 05 and 13, which is the specific thing the rubric asked to be checked.
10_first_run shows a real empty state rather than a fixture - 0 events, a single scrap reading "first one's yours." - so the regions do degrade to nothing when the log is empty.
verdict: I judged the five .mp4 clips from their frame strips in evidence/crops/ and from evidence/logs/*.report.json, not from playback, because nothing in this container decodes them; everything I assert about 06, 07, 08, 11 and 15 comes from six sampled frames each and is caveated accordingly. What the ten stills show is one very convincing shell wrapped around regions that are not all wired to the same thing. The shell is excellent and consistent: one tab bar, one palette (hue centres 55-95 degrees across all ten), two type roles used the same way everywhere, one rail treatment for state declarations that holds identically across four artifacts, one delivery-state vocabulary with none of the anti-goal voice in it, and a fourteen-row interrupt matrix in Settings that is the strongest evidence in the set that a fifth module could be added without rework. But Moments, one of the five regions, is not a view onto the log at all in this capture - one photograph in about fifteen tiles, six tiles frozen on the loading sentence "still fetching the picture.", at least three tiles that are bare dated paper, and a column headed WHAT WE FELT that contains no feeling from the 34 the app ships. That is the row's first clause failing in the artifact, and it blocks. Under it sit two more seams of the same kind: a flat beige rectangle with a drop shadow and standard deviation 1.4 sitting in the Chat stream where an event should be, and a setup screen whose desk is a flat fill (standard deviation 2.2, 121 colours) where every other screen has photographed grain (standard deviation 67-78, thousands of colours). The feeling, which is the reason the app exists, renders four different ways across the evidence - as its object in Chat, as a bare name in 08, as a blank card labelled "pigeon" in 15, and not at all in Moments - and the clip named for a feeling landing ends on a Pulse identical to the one it started on. DIFF.json carries its SSIM half honestly and its label half is empty for me to fill; every SSIM is 1.0, which means none of this moved since the last capture. The two missing Android artifacts are a reason and not an excuse and I have counted them once, but they leave the platform half of this row with no artifact behind it. 11 of 15, below the floor of 13.
